descriere:
ABC Human Capital este urmarea fireasca a experientei castigate de fondatorul companiei, in acest domeniu vast, complex, provocator, in continua miscare si schimbare al resurselor umane. Anul 2005 a reprezentat momentul concretizarii unui ideal: fondarea unei agentii de recrutare si executive search ce pune la dispozitia clientilor sai atat consultanta in recrutare si headhunting, precum si intreaga gama de servicii aferente capitalului uman. Adaptam cu succes noile tendinte din domeniul Resurselor Umane si utilizam creativ oportunitatile pe care le ofera mediul economic pentru atingerea target-urilor comerciale si de comunicare ale partenerilor nostri. Activitatea noastra se traduce in solutii inteligente bazate pe baze de date complete si complexe, aplicatii web, portaluri de informare si socializare, baterii de teste concepute si implementate impreuna cu fiecare dintre parteneri, campanii de marketing online si headhunting.
Position Overview: The Technical Support Specialist will take care of the pre-sales and after-sales technical assistance to the customers of a specific country/area. Providing Technical Support means offering: Customer support during the selection, installation, and commissioning of products. Advices and solutions for the optimal use of products and troubleshooting. The service offered guides the customer towards successfully resolving their needs, leaving a positive perception of the service received. Training, support, and daily synergy within the Headquarter ensure prompt and high-quality support to the customer, even for the most complex activities.
